Key Product Features

Warms milk and water, anywhere

Heat a bottle of milk or water at the park, in the car or mid-flight. No kettle, hob or microwave needed.

Heats fast, with a long battery life

Quick heating means a hungry baby isn’t left waiting, and a long-lasting rechargeable battery keeps it ready for days out and long journeys.

Simple buttons and a clear temperature display make it effortless for anyone, from new parents to grandparents on babysitting duty.

How it works

1Fill

Add your milk or water to the warmer.

2Warm

Press the button and let it heat. A quiet beep lets you know your milk or water has reached the temperature you chose.

3Feed

Check the temperature and feed your baby, wherever you are.
